school.name: Eagle Academy for Young Men
school.overview:
The Eagle Academy for Young Men is a college-preparatory school committed to our guiding principles and core values of C.L.E.A.R. (Confidence, Leadership, Effort, Academic Excellence, Resilience). We are part of the Eagle network of schools throughout New York City, supported by the Eagle Academy Foundation. Rigorous academic opportunities include AP courses, CUNY College Now, FutureReadyNYC program, and off-site internships with  Genesys and Co-Op Tech. We are in the second year of the FutureReady NYC Program in which we provide selected high school scholars with work-based learning and a pathway for scholars to pursue careers in Education & Teaching.  We partner with parents so that our young men demonstrate academic progress and personal growth. Our young men are expected to wear the Eagle uniform and participate in our school's unique rituals that contribute to our school's culture and spirit of brotherhood. Scholars have opportunities to participate in extra-curricular sports and activities, join our middle and high school NYJTL after school programs, and receive additional after-school academic support through our partner organizations. We make learning experiences at Eagle more meaningful and relevant by helping scholars discover their passions and develop their skills to become more focused and successful both inside and outside of the classroom.

Students attending our school are eligible to apply to the Bronx STEAM Center. Students accepted to Bronx STEAM will spend a portion of their school day and at least two years engaging in high quality Career and Technical Education classes at the Bronx STEAM Center in one of six career pathways aligned to critical sectors such as healthcare and technology. With support across our school and the Bronx STEAM Center, students will earn early college credit, industry credentials, participate in paid work experiences and receive personalized advising to graduate onto higher education and/or employment in family sustaining careers.

programs.name: The Eagle Academy for Young Men (X99X)
programs.description: Our program offers all Regents courses, higher-level math and science courses, computer science courses, and AP courses. All students have access to CUNY College Now courses, extra curricular activities and internships. We partner with The Eagle Academy Foundation to support our academic and extracurricular programs. New students to Eagle are expected to attend orientation courses in the summer.
